scholarships.title: MEXT Research Students Scholarship
scholarships.description: Graduate research route, including master's and doctoral study. The official overview says applicants must be under 35 and eligible for graduate admission. Embassy and university routes have different requirements; check the latest guidelines and your local Japanese embassy or university.
scholarships.funding_notes: The official overview lists tuition exemption, a monthly stipend and round-trip airfare. Amounts and conditions depend on the route and current guidelines; check which costs are covered for your award.

scholarships.title: DAAD Study Scholarships for STEM Disciplines
scholarships.description: For high-achieving applicants from eligible developing and emerging countries pursuing a full-time, on-campus STEM master's in Germany. A recognised first degree is required; applicants who already hold a master's at the deadline are ineligible. Check country eligibility and language requirements with DAAD.
scholarships.funding_notes: The listed award includes a monthly stipend, insurance, study allowance and a travel allowance on application. DAAD does not pay tuition fees and requires a tuition-free programme; other costs may remain. Check the current announcement for exact terms.

scholarships.title: Australian Government Research Training Program
scholarships.description: Supports domestic and overseas students undertaking research master's or research doctorates at participating Australian providers. Apply directly to a university and check its eligibility, research programme, selection rules and deadlines.
scholarships.funding_notes: An award can include one or more of a tuition fee offset, living stipend and allowances. Coverage varies by university and award; full funding is not confirmed.
